subject: Labour leader Keir Starmer, apparently swearing at a staffer
called_fake_by: Labour sources and Conservative MPs, including Simon Clarke and Tom Tugendhat
claim: On the opening day of Labour's conference, an anonymous account posted audio of a voice like Starmer's berating a staffer. Politicians from both major parties said it was fake.
finding: Full Fact found no evidence the clip was genuine, but its audio expert couldn't determine whether it was synthetic. Cross-party denials show who called it fake. They don't show how it was made.
outcome: Labour officials told Bloomberg that X declined their requests to take it down, saying it needed more proof the audio was fake. X didn't respond to Bloomberg's request for comment.
